page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.g7 family, built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance provides 128 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 128 vCPUs. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps to support high-throughput network operations. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high core density offer predictable performance for enterprise workloads without the resource contention typical of shared-core environments.

The ecs.g7.32xlarge is designed for large-scale applications requiring significant compute and memory resources. Suitable workloads include enterprise-grade databases, large-scale web serving, containerized microservices, continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, and distributed data processing tasks.
